title: Show What You Can Do: Making Weekend Plans
description: A friend calls about the weekend: questions, plurals, past and future, all in one chat.

exercises.context: Your friend calls: there's a festival at the temple tomorrow.

line.english: Will you come to the temple tomorrow?

feedback.grammar: వస్తారా? (will you come?) → వస్తాను (I will come). The -ా asks; the -ను answers.

choices.whyWrong: That's the future (వెళ్తాను) but they asked about yesterday.
“The school is there”: true, but not what they asked.

exercises.context: They're stopping by the shop on the way.

line.telugu: నేను పండ్లు తీసుకుంటాను. మీకు ఏమి కావాలి?
line.transliteration: nēnu paṇḍlu tīsukuṇṭānu. mīku ēmi kāvāli?
line.english: I'm getting fruit. What do you want?

feedback.grammar: కూడా right after నాకు: “I too want fruit.”

exercises.prompt: Wrap up the call: tell them you'll come tomorrow.

cultureCards.title: You're building sentences now
cultureCards.body: Questions, answers, past, future, plurals, and 'me too': you just used the core machinery of Telugu grammar in one phone call.

author: seed-content
